title: Things to do in Midland this week: Family day, silversmith class and a free concert - NewsBreak
text:
By B. Kay Richter ,
6 hours ago Sewell Kia is inviting community members to a Kia Family Day slated from 12 p.m. to 2 p.m. Saturday, Jan. 17. Guests are welcome to enjoy a family-friendly cookout with activities for kids. (Stefania Pelfini la Waziya/Getty Images) Every week, our staff scans local calendars to find the best ways to spend your time. Here’s a short list of Midland’s events you won’t want to miss this week.
Want to recommend an event? Submit it to us at mrt.com/communitysubmissions .
Sewell Kia Family Day Sewell Kia is inviting community members to a Kia Family Day scheduled from noon to 2 p.m. Saturday, Jan. 17, at the new Sewell Kia, 5715 Andrews Highway in Midland. Guests are welcome to enjoy a family-friendly cookout and activities for kids.
This event also provides the opportunity to meet the Sewell Kia team, explore the new facility, and ask questions of associates, whether interested in vehicles, services or simply learning more about what makes the Sewell experience unique.
Silversmith class Learn the art of silversmithing with step-by-step guidance from an experienced silversmith. No experience is necessary. The class is scheduled from 2 to 6 p.m. Saturday, Jan. 17, at the Boardwalk LLC, 712 W. Scharbauer Drive in Midland. Pick a favorite stone and create your own sterling silver ring. Snacks and drinks are provided. The class is expected to last up to four hours, depending on the size of the class. The cost of the class is $130 per person. Book online for details.
Singing Women of Texas Residents are invited to join a free concert hosted by the Singing Women of Texas, West chapter. The free concert is from 6 to 8 p.m. Saturday, Jan. 17, at Cotton Flat Baptist Church, 6409 S. State Highway 349 in Midland.
